# v0.1.17

## 中文

- 优化中英文界面布局，桌面端与手机端显示更加协调，浅色和深色模式下的按钮、标签与账号池更清晰。
- 将巡检说明移至标题旁的帮助入口，并按功能分行展示，便于区分开始巡检、增量巡检、巡检当前分类和抽检。
- 统一并发、抽检数量和抽检比例输入框的居中对齐，改善手机端填写体验。
- 修复 CPA 使用自定义端口时，后台自动巡检、自动禁用和解禁操作仍连接默认端口的问题（[#22](https://github.com/ywddd/grok-inspection/issues/22)）。
- 修复 CPA 更新或容器重建后，自动巡检设置恢复默认值的问题，已保存的设置会继续生效（[#23](https://github.com/ywddd/grok-inspection/issues/23)）。

## English

- Refined the bilingual layout for a more consistent desktop and mobile experience, with clearer controls, labels, and account pools in both light and dark themes.
- Moved inspection guidance into a help entry beside the title and split it into separate lines for full, incremental, category, and sample inspections.
- Centered the worker, sample count, and sample percentage inputs to improve mobile data entry.
- Fixed background inspection, auto-ban, and unban actions using the default CPA port when a custom port is configured ([#22](https://github.com/ywddd/grok-inspection/issues/22)).
- Fixed scheduled inspection settings reverting to defaults after a CPA update or container recreation; saved settings now remain effective ([#23](https://github.com/ywddd/grok-inspection/issues/23)).
